scientific_integrity: Explicit constructive proof and reproducible finite checks are supplied. No external or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the full strong filtration-induced matching complex of unfilled four-cycle bouquets with at least two petals. The one-petal boundary case is separately computed. No result is claimed for arbitrary cactus graphs, other cycle lengths, ordinary matching or pure strong matching complexes. Finite executable checks cover one through three petals; the all-parameter proof is structural. Bibliographic overlap with unindexed sources remains possible.
title: A sphere after two squares: strong discrete-Morse complexes of four-cycle bouquets
